Impact & Stories

Impact is more than a number.

Behind community work are people who contribute time, food, care and effort. This is where we share the stories and records that help explain Aashray’s journey.

Our impact archive

Our impact archive is being documented. We are bringing together activity information, photographs and video records so our work can be shared clearly and responsibly.

Activity records and verified reporting are being prepared. No unverified totals are displayed.
